text:
carol: FYI the canary that flips on strict tool-hook schema is generating a bump in schema_reject_rate and downstream backoffs. noticed by CS via elevated error tickets. anyone digging in? :mag:

mike: looking. quick sample from logs — a handful of partner adapters are sending an extra `extra_info` block alongside the expected `tool`+`output`. validator is strict and we reject.

```
{
  "tool": "payment_link",
  "output": { "url": "https://pay..." },
  "extra_info": { "attempts": 2 }
}
```

jess: telemetry shows ~0.45% rejects overall but concentrated on two high-traffic routes which explains user-visible latency spikes when fallbacks run.

sam: tactical options:
- immediate rollback of strict on canary (safe)
- or switch validator to soft-accept unknown top-level fields (fast change)
- change fallback to a cheaper model variant instead of full reconciliation to reduce cost blowup

carol: I want rollback now and then a fast follow to add per-adapter visibility in Console. ops needs to be able to message the adapter owners.

mike: we already emit adapter_id in logs. can add adapter slice to the per-route widget and surface a sample failing payload. patch is small:

```
emit("schema_reject_rate", {route, adapter_id, model, reject_action})
```

jess: +1 to tagging `reject_action` with drop|soft_allow|strict_fail so we can filter noise vs hard failures.

ops-bot: Canary 2026-06-17T09:12:03Z: feature flag "strict_toolhook_validation" ENABLED on canary-4 (traffic 4%)

sam: note: strict failures cause double work — orchestration path re-runs selection + reranking + tool call. propose a fallback throttle: if reject_rate for route > 0.5% route to `cheap-v1` model instead of full fallback.

carol: actions: (1) rollback strict flag on canary, (2) add adapter_id slice + sample payload to Console, (3) add `reject_action` tag in telemetry, (4) implement fallback throttle to cheap variant. I'll write a short RFC proposing a long-term strategy: soft-validate + automated repair hints for adapters.

mike: rolling back now.

jess: I’ll update the ops runbook and tag affected customers for outreach when the console slice is live.

sam: opened GH issue infra#4387 for the fallback throttle PR.

carol: thx all, please drop a one-line changelog so CS knows what to expect. :thumbsup:
